testcase.name: Scenario: Navigate backward through the new-project wizard: tmp/obk-bdd-project-wPhRV5Dm/checkout/features/application/project-dialog/project-dialog.feature:57:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Navigate backward through the new-project wizard ✔ Given the new single-user project wizard is on its project-type page in the MCAD Software ✔ When the user chooses Next ✔ Then the project-file page displays the project name and workspace folder ✔ When the user chooses Next ✔ Then the Select Libraries page is displayed ✔ When the user chooses Back ✔ Then the project-file page is displayed ✔ And its project name and workspace folder remain displayed ✔ When the user chooses Back ✔ Then the project-type page is displayed ✔ And New Single User Project remains selected ✔ And Back and Finish are unavailable ✔ When the user chooses Cancel ✔ Then the wizard closes and the Projects dialog is displayed
